arguments.sql:
WITH scores AS (
    SELECT name, version, step,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN model = 'Stack' THEN 1 END) AS stack_rows,
           MAX(CASE WHEN model = 'Stack' THEN test_score END) AS stack_test_score,
           MAX(CASE WHEN model <> 'Stack' THEN test_score END) AS other_test_score
    FROM main.model_score
    GROUP BY name, version, step
),
model_keys AS (
    SELECT name, version, step, COUNT(*) AS model_rows
    FROM main.model
    GROUP BY name, version, step
),
audit AS (
    SELECT 'model by category' AS source, L1_model AS category, COUNT(*) AS row_count
    FROM main.model
    GROUP BY L1_model
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'stack_ok by category and status', L1_model || ', ' || status, COUNT(*)
    FROM main.stack_ok
    GROUP BY L1_model, status
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'scored comparison by stored category',
           L1_model || ', ' || CASE WHEN stack_test_score > other_test_score THEN 'Stack higher'
                                    WHEN stack_test_score = other_test_score THEN 'equal'
                                    WHEN stack_test_score < other_test_score THEN 'Stack lower'
                                    ELSE 'missing score' END,
           COUNT(*)
    FROM main.model
    LEFT JOIN scores USING (name, version, step)
    GROUP BY 2
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'model key multiplicity', CAST(model_rows AS TEXT), COUNT(*)
    FROM model_keys
    GROUP BY model_rows
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Stack rows per score key', CAST(stack_rows AS TEXT), COUNT(*)
    FROM scores
    GROUP BY stack_rows
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'category values per name and version', CAST(category_count AS TEXT), COUNT(*)
    FROM (
        SELECT name, version, COUNT(DISTINCT L1_model) AS category_count
        FROM main.model
        GROUP BY name, version
    )
    GROUP BY category_count
)
SELECT source, category, row_count
FROM audit
ORDER BY source, category

WITH comparison_keys AS (
    SELECT name, version, step
    FROM main.model_score
    GROUP BY name, version, step
    HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN model = 'Stack' THEN 1 END) > 0
       AND COUNT(CASE WHEN model <> 'Stack' THEN 1 END) > 0
),
category_counts AS (
    SELECT m.L1_model, COUNT(*) AS total_count
    FROM main.model AS m
    JOIN comparison_keys USING (name, version, step)
    GROUP BY m.L1_model
)
SELECT L1_model, total_count
FROM category_counts
WHERE total_count = (SELECT MAX(total_count) FROM category_counts)
